proof_body:
by
  intro F S
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩ ε hε
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.1 hf (ε / 2) (half_pos hε))
    refine ⟨K, fun m n hm hn x hx => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hK m hm x hx
    have h2 := hK n hn x hx
    rw [← Real.dist_eq]
    exact (dist_triangle_left _ _ (f x)).trans_lt (by linarith)
  · intro h
    have hlim : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ l : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => F n x) Filter.atTop (nhds l) := by
      intro x hx
      apply cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete
      refine Metric.cauchySeq_iff.2 fun ε hε => ?_
      obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := h ε hε
      exact ⟨K, fun m hm n hn => by
        rw [Real.dist_eq]
        exact hK m n hm hn x hx⟩
    choose! f hf using hlim
    refine ⟨f, Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.2 fun ε hε => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := h (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    refine Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨K, fun n hn x hx => ?_⟩
    have h1 : dist (f x) (F n x) ≤ ε / 2 := by
      have t := (hf x hx).dist (tendsto_const_nhds (x := F n x))
      refine le_of_tendsto t (Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨K, fun m hm => ?_⟩)
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      exact (hK m n hm hn x hx).le
    linarith
target_source: ∀ (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ), (∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, TendstoUniformlyOn F f Filter.atTop S) ↔ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ m n : ℕ, K ≤ m → K ≤ n → ∀ x ∈ S, |F m x - F n x| < ε
